desc: LCPO (ICLR 2025) on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B6.
Host hyperparameters are IDENTICAL to ippo/config1.json so an arm
difference cannot be an algorithm difference. Everything under 'lcpo' is
either the authors' own value (sourced in the comment below) or a value
URB forces, and those are listed in docs/baselines/CHECKLIST_lcpo.md.
Sources for the 'lcpo' block:
trpo_kl_in/out, trpo_damping, ood_subsample, value_lr  ->
LCPO/windy-gym/run_config_phase1.py, the 'lcpo_continual' entry:
--trpo_kl_in 1e-1 --trpo_kl_out 1e-4 --trpo_damping 1e-1
--ood_subsample 100 --val_lr_rate 1e-3 --n_hid 64 64
ood_dist/lcpo_thresh -> LCPO/windy-gym/param.py defaults (l2, -9), i.e.
every reservoir anchor is used. The paper's --lcpo_thresh 1 is in
the units of a 6-D wind context and does not transfer to a rainfall
intensity in [0, 1]; see the checklist, item OOD-3.
master_batch -> LCPO's own per-algorithm setting (200 for LCPO, 3200
for TRPO in the same sweep). On URB it must be shorter than the
context's coherence time; the declared rule is max(8, period//5).
auto_target_entropy -> null: the host's fixed entropy_coef is used so
the exploration pressure matches every other arm. Set 0.1 to
reproduce the authors' auto-tuned entropy exactly.
